steps.content: The Base

Although it's called a base, it's really just a large underground space found in the abandoned Inner Bay. Once the contamination is cleaned up and some cover and basic setup are in place, it's habitable.

The first to move in were the non-combatants evacuated from the Drifter Camp by Julien during the W-31 reclaiming operation. With the rising number of refugees and relocation of the bases, the population here now fluctuates between six and seven thousand.
[Scene Change] Any Small Room
After sending Hecate away, Matilda closes the door again.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Hecate is disheartened. All this time, she's been waiting for news of that person.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I can't exactly tell her we do have news, can I? Those behind her are up to no good. If anything happens to that Chief, that poor little girl will certainly never forgive herself.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Then make sure that she doesn't find out.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: One must get a closer look to understand what's the deal with the shackles, right? You know about the situation.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Before we get into that, can't you untie me first, my dear Adjutant? I risked my life to bring you information. Let's settle our personal scores another time.

The man calls himself Donald. He was placed in the Executive Committee in November, N.F. 112. Some higher-up vouched for his deep understanding of Rustfire and his ability to handle related matters. Despite that, Donald is not highly regarded internally. His eccentric behavior has even earned him some rumors that he was an escapee from the Banyan Psychiatric Hospital.

It was also this man who helped Matilda hide her Mania infection and brought someone to stop her mutation into a Corruptor. Eventually, Matilda survived and became a Sinner. But as the price of keeping her secret, she's also been forced to clean up many laughable messes.

Donald's past records have been destroyed and it's a mystery which side he's on. There are rumors within the Executive Committee that he has another backer and that he's a spy planted by some infamous Paradeisian big shot. But to Matilda, this man's relationship with Rustfire is even more ambiguous.

Matilda is very certain that from the day he put on the Executive Officer uniform, Donald has been secretly supporting the Drifter Camp. But until now, Donald refuses to contact Rustfire directly or explain anything.
The adjutant pulls over a chair and sits in front of Donald, organizing the documents.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Since you're here, please give me some guidance. Rustfire's current situation is tricky.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: The number of refugees received at each location is increasing, and smuggling proves a less and less reliable way to gather materials. There have been several food shortages, not to mention other rare goods.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: The Underground is still secretly catalyzing Mania. W-31 doesn't produce enough Hypercubes to fulfill protection needs. They have no choice but to combine the bases to reduce consumption, but a concentrated base makes an easier target for the Executive Committee's patrols.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Now, the Black Ring is no longer their biggest threat. The Underground and Paradeisos's policy are both squeezing the little survival space of West District.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hmm... I see. Then I have only one suggestion: I strongly suggest everyone run away with me.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's a big world out there. They can go somewhere even the Black Ring, Paradeisos, and the Underground can't reach and wait it out. Staying alive should come first.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: There's no such utopia. The whole world has long been tightly bound together by Mania and other disasters.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Whether it's Eastside, satellite towns, or the Outlands, not a single place will accept refugees from West District. Infected or not, they are turned away by all as the source of Mania, just like what happened to Sinners in the past.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Then why not create a new world? I hear from many guys out there that things are changing every day, now there are plenty of good shelters outside.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Isn't Syndicate always so proud of its builders? Then go out and build history again! Stop clinging to past glory.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: To start from scratch and set up new settlements, the pioneers need to be stronger, firmer, and more proactive. The people of West District don't have it in them anymore.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Rustfire's fall has taken a hefty toll. People have lost hope and motivation. The morale only keeps plummeting.
Matilda slightly lowers her gaze.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I'm just an Executive Officer from Eastside. I can't truly understand what they're facing and feeling.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: So, do you really plan to not talk with the Rustfire executives? They've been looking for a new leader.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Cough cough! Are you serious?
Matilda looks up at Donald. She's changed the topic rather abruptly, but her expression is completely serious.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...I've seen what happens to leaders. Not appealing at all. That's not what I'm after.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I want to be like... a catfish! Like what I'm doing now, playing at being a crazy Executive Officer who's good for nothing.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You know, every time I show up, everyone gets so worked up. Even the most unmotivated individual rushes over for a punch the second they see me! They're instantly energized! Not even a leader has this effect on people, right?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I hate to break it to you, but the catfish effect is made up and has no scientific basis. But I understand your attitude now.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: You understand thoroughly what difficulties the refugees are facing. You won't just sit back and watch. I'm sure you have other plans.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Why have you been frequenting the refugee camps recently? These injuries weren't caused by humans. Where were you just now and what did you do?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Does this have to do with that Chief?
Donald scratches his head. His jests never seem to be able to distract an upright person like her. It's a good thing, in a way.
Later, when facing other difficult situations, the adjutant will surely remain as unwavering as ever.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You're quite perceptive, I must say. I knew you were a remarkable talent.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Yes... I just returned to the Drifter Camp, down to the monument at the very bottom, to meet with some old friends.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's a problem brought by the Black Ring. We must consult a Black Ring Expert.
[Scene change] Inside the dilapidated Drifter Camp

6 hours ago.
The core of the Drifter Camp's contamination,
Romanesque Monument

During the Rustfire uprising, this was where the rioters welcomed back their deceased "leader", received the Mania disguised as the shackles, and spiraled into madness. When the Black Ring erupted, this was also where they degenerated into Corruptors, turning the Drifter Camp into a ghost town.
It takes a lot of effort to get to the heart of this place. For some, however, only the most dangerous places can provide cover.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Look who's here, a respected Executive Officer! Did you get beaten up while patrolling around our turf? Told you, you should change your clothes next time. These people here won't spare this skin of yours even if they've turned into Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: The person you're looking for is down there. I'm playing the suona every day at the door to keep him alive. If I keep this up, you won't be able to afford the performance fee even if you sell the whole DisCity. Hurry up and bring him back.
steps.female_content: The person you're looking for is down there. I'm playing the suona every day at the door to keep her alive. If I keep this up, you won't be able to afford the performance fee even if you sell the whole DisCity. Hurry up and bring her back.

steps.content: [Scene change] The contaminated Romanesque Monument

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: There's no need to thank me. I'm not here to safeguard anyone's life. I'm simply attracted by the hundreds of souls here, and I want to hear their ravings. It's only a coincidence we ran into each other.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: If you really feel like you owe me, then I'd ask you to stop obsessing over saving him. Don't be so hard on yourself. Just let go. That way, everyone can find relief sooner.
steps.female_content: If you really feel like you owe me, then I'd ask you to stop obsessing over saving her. Don't be so hard on yourself. Just let go. That way, everyone can find relief sooner.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: That one made a promise to come to me after death. Hehe... I've been looking forward to it.
[Scene change] Dark tunnel

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: Stop shouting. I'm not dead, just not in the mood to see anyone... I'm not useless like you. I don't need to be glued to him to protect him. Even if I stay hidden, the spies from Paradeisos and the Underground can't get anywhere near him.
steps.female_content: Stop shouting. I'm not dead, just not in the mood to see anyone... I'm not useless like you. I don't need to be glued to her to protect her. Even if I stay hidden, the spies from Paradeisos and the Underground can't get anywhere near her.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: Tsk, that idiot Chief should have known better than to keep up the pretty talk and suicidal missions in these times. Now I gotta be the babysitter.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: Hurry with waking him up and get him out of here! I can't stand looking at that dumb face anymore!
steps.female_content: Hurry with waking her up and get her out of here! I can't stand looking at that dumb face anymore!

steps.content: After taking several turns and thanking several pals, Donald finally reaches the end of the passage and pushes the door open, then closes it behind him. He shivers.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: These pretty ladies around you keep getting scarier. Coming to see you is like venturing into the gates of hell. It's taking years off my life.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: We've only talked once before, and yet I've put myself through all this torture for you. I've worked too hard. I'd best get some payback in the future!
[Small CG1, Chief in fluid]

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Wake up soon, Chief. If you don't, I'm gonna have to make you.
[Scene Change, Exit Flashback] Room in the Base
Back in that top-secret makeshift prison cell, Donald is now wearing a different expression.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That BR-002 is more powerful than we think. It'll be nine years old after December. It died once and came back to life, and can even hide itself. After getting hooked up with ${PlayerName}'s shackles, it turned the tables and corrupted the shackles instead, contaminating hundreds of Rustfire followers...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: This is the largest and strongest Black Ring since the great explosion. If left unchecked, the entire West District will be devoured, as if DisSea expanded several times over, flooding half of the city-state... Even Eastside and Paradeisos can't turn a blind eye any longer.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But the strangest thing is that after its second outbreak, BR-002 has stopped expanding. Although contamination is still leaking, the boundary of the Black Ring remains stable. Corruptors rarely come out to harm people. Even the monsters outside have gradually returned to the Black Ring, never coming out again.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Although the FAC is working hard, their anti-Mania wall can only act as a cage. It can't turn the beast in the cage into a docile kitten. Compared to nine years ago, this Black Ring's personality has completely changed.
He leans back in his chair, squinting slightly at the ceiling.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's as if it's in a chokehold, left completely immobile...

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Are you suggesting that... Mania and an anti-Mania force coexist in the Black Ring? Is it the shackles?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: After all, that's Paradeisos's secret weapon. It wouldn't hurt to have some faith in him, would it?
steps.female_content: After all, that's Paradeisos's secret weapon. It wouldn't hurt to have some faith in her, would it?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Over the past six months, our little Chief has likely been fighting tooth and nail with the Black Ring and that monster in some unseen place. Judging from Hella and Hecate's situation, it's clear that the shackles are also struggling. That's why I've thought of a way to lend him a hand.
steps.female_content: Over the past six months, our little Chief has likely been fighting tooth and nail with the Black Ring and that monster in some unseen place. Judging from Hella and Hecate's situation, it's clear that the shackles are also struggling. That's why I've thought of a way to lend her a hand.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's too complicated so I won't get into the specifics. To put it simply, it's like a tug of war. Give this side a bit of a boost, tickle that side a little, then you win. Easy-peasy. Sounds good? Isn't my strategy so imaginative?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Are you going alone again? Even for such a dangerous operation, you're leaving on your own without telling anyone?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hehe, can't let anyone overshadow me on such a cool and crazy operation, can I?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Alright, don't worry. I've already secured an assistant, an ally, and some strong backup too. It's foolproof.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: If something really happens, don't I still have my great escape plan? Told ya, it's foolproof.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Don't hesitate to let me know if you need my help. I can fight too.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Of course, when have I ever hesitated? I'm leaving the folks here and a bunch of cuties in your care.

He jumps off, stretches lazily, then waves his hand and leaves, the ropes on his body already cut off somehow. It's exactly due to this kind of behavior that both the Executive Committee and the refugee camp treat him like a madman.
Matilda doesn't deny his madness.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I don't believe the man who has done so much to help the refugees is just a madman. In places they can't see, you must have done even more.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: And it's true sometimes madness is the only solution to a desperate situation. Many people have gathered here for this madness of yours, seeking shelter, a way out, and an answer.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Regardless, everyone's fate is already tied together.
(Scene change)
The Shadow Guardian enters a study and turns on the light, letting it illuminate her petite figure.
In the dim light, she flips through the messy notes in the study. Most of them are just empty blank pages, with only faint colorless imprints pressed through the back of other sheets onto them.

This is a room filled with the works by the former Rustfire liaison, a self-proclaimed romantic poet and a showy teacher who hadn't yet received her qualification. There isn't much of her handwriting left in Syndicate today.
(Scene change)

Having just organized the relocation of the base, Lavina immediately takes over all of its logistics. She's pulled an all-nighter. Before going to sleep, she remembers that Hella's dressing needs to be changed and Hecate might not have eaten, so she gets ready and heads to the infirmary.
But when she arrives at the tightly closed door, she hesitates.
In the end, the woman simply leaves the supplies outside Hella's ward, gently knocks on the door, and silently turns to leave.
(Scene change)
Matilda looks at the either exhausted or frightened faces around her. The future is so uncertain. No one here can be unfazed by the unknown. No one can be above the confusion. Including herself.

She believes in the glimmer of hope that Executive Officer Donald mentioned, but she also sees that the plan is very risky. It's especially reckless and crazy to be proposing it at this juncture. Donald may seem mad, but deep down he is cautious with his actions.
Then why the sudden decision to act now?
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Because hope expires too, and the time window left for us is very narrow now.

Donald emerges from the underground tunnel, returning to the ruins of Syndicate. The resurrected Black Ring is right in front of him, inevitably visible to everyone's eyes from every corner of Syndicate above ground.

The red halo encircles a pitch-black high tower. It twists slightly like a mirage, seeming to grow continuously upward and tumbling down incessantly at the same time. It looks like it could collapse at any moment, destroying the long-crumbling half of the city-state.
Indeed, this war doesn't leave him much time.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: In your eyes, is the Black Ring effectively constrained and unable to expand? Hehe... That's different from what I hear.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Recently, the revenants who have come to me after dying of Mania are all agitated. They told me that the master of the Black Ring has been accumulating power and will soon regain freedom. Whatever it is that binds it, it can't hold on anymore.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: I'm not joking with you, take him away immediately. An Undergrounder came here a week ago and I made him bloom. That Undergrounder carried a special sorcery on his body to mark his own death, all for tracking ${PlayerName} down. I think the location's been exposed.
steps.female_content: I'm not joking with you, take her away immediately. An Undergrounder came here a week ago and I made him bloom. That Undergrounder carried a special sorcery on his body to mark his own death, all for tracking ${PlayerName} down. I think the location's been exposed.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: But since then... the Underground hasn't sent anyone else. Something must be going on. You guys be careful.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Yes, things aren't looking good. If I'm not mistaken, those guys from the Underground and their Shepherd are all in action. You've seen what she's capable of. Don't think about taking her on yourself.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: But on the other hand... this also opens up opportunities, a slight possibility to save the Chief. After all, those people know Mania best. Perhaps they hold the solution to it too.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Pulling the chestnuts out of the fire... What do you say? I can contact our ally for you.
[Small CG - Long shot of Chief]

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Gotta hold on to the backup, meet up with the ally, stay alive, and hurry my ass up...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Sigh, my dear Chief, the stranger Donald is gonna risk his life for you this time. Just to put some pressure on you before I go.
[Small CG - Long Shot]

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Whether it's to return my favor, save the world, or just to hug someone waiting for you... Come back soon. You'd best open your eyes now.
[Small CG - Close-up of Donald]

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Any later... I'm afraid some things can't be undone.
[Return to the street]
Donald drapes the Executive Officer's coat over his shoulder, whistling and swinging his arm as he heads toward the high tower.
Not far behind him, a block away, a gloomy girl in a cloak keeps her eyes fixed on her prey, quietly following at a distance without being noticed.
It's been eight months. Hecate is tired of waiting. This time, she must look for news of that important person herself. This is for her own mission, and also for... Hella.
